Predeclared and launched spatial-chain-followup-v1 using the unchanged compiled a3827bfd engine: (1) OASIS 11 step-scaled-fine1.5 fine end (event 44, saved loss 0.43737469002775886), (2) OASIS 13 selected-control fine start (event 23, loss 0.5306432661019224), (3) OASIS 13 selected-control fine end (event 44, loss 0.41630979486853564). All three source fits are terminal; raw checkpoint, event stream, fit receipt, images, fixed fitting mask, engine and driver hashes are sealed. Selection is fixed before these derivative results, with no output-based replacement. The same three directions, eight perturbations and 0.005/decreasing-error criterion remain; any failed objective reproduction, missing derivative support, process error or failed direction stays in the three-attempt denominator. No optimizer policy or fresh qualification subject is added.

The follow-up validator independently reconstructs finite differences from plus/minus losses and all three reported relative-error formulas. Four focused tests pass for the threshold/convergence rule, incomplete support, missing/nonfinite measurements and falsely reported error. Applied to the completed pilot, its verdicts and support summary reproduce exactly. This remains observed OASIS fine-scale replication: additional cohorts, coarse scales, image order, boundaries, applicable regularization and anatomical trials remain open. First 29-state offline export/scoring and the full trajectory panel continue independently.
